claim: The demo uses sample data, never real workspace data
sandbox: fresh browser context; reset demo; assert its workspace token changes and real storage stays empty

claim: Clients open proof links without an account
sandbox: create demo proof; open its link in a fresh browser context without workspace storage
create a demo proof; force its server expiry into the past; assert the API returns 410 Gone

claim: Approved extras appear in the next-visit CSV
sandbox: choose an extra on demo proof; return to workspace; download CSV and assert the row

claim: Demo actions send data only to this service
sandbox: record every request while loading a fresh demo; assert every origin matches the product

claim: Businesses choose which extras appear on client proof pages
sandbox: add an extra in the demo workspace; open its proof page and assert that extra appears

claim: The $59 license starts at Sociobot billing, opens Dodo's payment page, and supports license restore
where: landing price section, privacy, terms, and README
sandbox: own empty browser context; wait for explicit form readiness; assert the live public Sociobot registry has this $59 product and redirects to Dodo; restore a license through a valid mocked response delayed past the former seven-second race

claim: Every API route except health is limited by forwarded client IP
sandbox: send 45 non-mutating API requests as one forwarded client; assert a 429 response with Retry-After

claim: The free plan accepts three completed visits; a valid business license permits more
sandbox: create real workspaces; assert visits one through three return 201, the fourth returns 402, a fixture-verified license permits it, and eight concurrent free writes create exactly three visits
create a demo; assert its TTL is no more than 24 hours; force expiry and assert workspace access is rejected

claim: No third-party fonts, scripts, or analytics load
sandbox: record all landing and demo requests in a fresh browser context; assert every request stays on the product origin

claim: Workspace and production proof access tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes
sandbox: create a real workspace and proof; inspect the database; assert raw tokens are absent and their SHA-256 hashes are present

claim: Visit details appear in proof links, while replies and chosen extras appear in the workspace and next-visit export
sandbox: use a fresh demo; inspect its proof, save a client reply and extra, then assert both the workspace and CSV show the saved result

claim: Technicians can add up to three consented photos under 1 MB each to a proof
sandbox: fresh demo; record a completed visit with an in-memory PNG and consent enabled; open its client proof and assert the named image is displayed from the saved data URL

claim: A client's problem report and rating are saved and returned to the workspace
sandbox: fresh demo proof; submit a problem with rating 2; assert the saved confirmation and the exact problem state and rating in the workspace

claim: The service starts without configuration variables and listens on port 8080 by default
sandbox: build the frontend and service; start the server binary with an empty environment; assert health and the landing document are served on 127.0.0.1:8080

claim: Private proof pages and proof API responses cannot be indexed or stored
where: private proof page and privacy policy
sandbox: fresh demo; open its proof URL and assert proof HTML and API responses send noindex and private no-store controls without a canonical URL

claim: Deployment verification checks one active writer, durable storage, state continuity, and rate limits
sandbox: deployed product; verify one active revision and replica, /data storage, 20 demo workspaces with 20 concurrent reads each, proof continuity, free-plan concurrency, and 45/130-request rate bursts
